title: Mixed Event — Play That Beautiful Sound! — Episode8 Admiration and Joy

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, life has been quiet for Toya. Just when he feels like trying something new, the owner of an instrument store who he owes a lot to asks him to deal with customers at an event!

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's eat!
Nom... Nom...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, hot! But this takoyaki's so good!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't go too fast, Shiraishi, or you're going to burn your mouth. Akiyama told me that it's good to split them in half and give them a second to cool.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! Mizuki doesn't get it!
They taste better when you complain about how hot they are!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, Toya, dig in!
The manager was nice enough to get these for us, and on top of our paychecks too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
It'd be rude of me not to have them while they're hot.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Although, I'm not sure how I feel about eating food while literally on the street. But without further ado...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what makes them kinda special, right?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe how well things went today!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we had quite a busy day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! Despite all the customers that came to visit, we didn't run into any big problems.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we didn't...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
We were so busy that I never really had a chance to digest what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm wondering if I did a good job with the customers...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha!
You're so modest, Toya.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Seriously, you were awesome!
All your customers seemed so happy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really?
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I was only able to do that because you helped me practice, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, you did great because you put in the effort!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought you did a really amazing job interacting with all of them today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only were you able to immediately give everybody details about each instrument... You had a lot of fun talking about them, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought it was great how you wanted to show them just how much fun playing music can be!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <An! Toya! Nice work today!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi, Rin, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<We saw everything!
Seeing that boy play the trumpet the way he wanted was so heartwarming!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
I got all giddy when he made that first sound!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Also, those other two girls.
I felt really glad when I saw them smile!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yoisaki and Asahina?
Yes, I really can't thank them enough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Them bringing that boy over gave me a chance to remember something very important.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Something very important?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
The sensation I felt when I first started playing music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My admiration for it, and the joy I felt whenever I was able to produce a beautiful sound.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll need to cherish these thoughts moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're about to take on the world, so I'm surely going to face more challenges... And even greater challenges, in the future.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm sure I'll be able to overcome them as long as I keep those memories in mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At least, that's what I believe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just being reminded of those things made helping with this convention completely worth it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you again, Shiraishi...
Rin, Len, you two as well.
Thank you for helping me practice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Don't hesitate to ask us if you ever need our help again, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
That's what friends are for, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Right...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I admire music and know what kind of joy it can bring... But that's not all I have.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now, I have friends who can help me reach new heights.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Friends who I can take on the world with.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. I couldn't ask for more...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm?
A message from the manager?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya, listen!
He said we were a huge help today and wants to thank us by taking us out for barbeque sometime!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What?
No, that seems like too much...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, don't worry about that! He's the one making the offer, after all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess you're right. It would be rude to turn down his kind offer.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. When we do go, I'm gonna order a bunch of prime galbi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to having some feather steak.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Feather steak? What part's that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The part below a cow's shoulder blade down to its forearm. Apparently, it's considered a very premium cut, and...
